data.name: Buraqoon
data.gender_notes: Buraqoon is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name 'Buraqoon' in Islamic tradition is derived from the name of the divine creature 'Buraq' which Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) rode during the Night Journey. This name signifies the radiance and spiritual illumination that one experiences on their spiritual journey. The name Buraqoon carries the meaning “Glowing Light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Buraqoon usually hope their child will grow to embody glowing light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine guidance and spiritual enlightenment.
data.etymology: Buraqoon belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Glowing Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Buraqoon total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Buraqoon' has cultural significance as it reminds us of the unique spiritual journey taken by Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) during the Night Journey. This name is revered in Islamic tradition and serves as a reminder of the prophet's divine connection to Allah (swt).
data.spiritual_significance: The name 'Buraqoon' holds deep spiritual significance as it represents the journey towards spiritual enlightenment and closeness to Allah (swt). It serves as a reminder of the inner light that one can cultivate through devotion, prayer, and contemplation, much like the radiant creature 'Buraq' that Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) rode during his Night Journey.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Buraq is a mystical beast mentioned in Hadith, carrying the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) during the Night Journey to Jerusalem and then to heaven. The name "Buraqoon" could symbolize being a carrier of spiritual blessings and divine guidance from the Prophet, or a vehicle for spiritual ascension and enlightenment. It is a reminder of the connection between the physical and spiritual worlds, and the importance of the journey towards inner transformation.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Al-Buraq is a mythical animal mentioned in Islamic tradition as a steed that carried the prophet Muhammad from the Al-Aqsa Mosque in Jerusalem to the 'Farthest Mosque', believed to be in Jerusalem or the Temple Mount, and back during the Night Journey.
historical_references.context: The Night Journey is an important event in Islamic tradition, said to have occurred on the night of ascension (Isra and Mi'raj) during which Muhammad is believed to have travelled from Mecca to Jerusalem and then to heaven.

historical_references.reference: Buraqoon is the term used in Arabic for the sacred enclosure of the Al-Aqsa Mosque, which was said to be the starting point of Muhammad's Night Journey on the back of the mythical steed, Al-Buraq.
historical_references.context: The Al-Aqsa Mosque is one of the most significant sites in Islamic tradition and is located in Jerusalem. The concept of the Night Journey and the role of Al-Buraq in Muslim belief became more prominent during this period as the Islamic presence in Jerusalem grew.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Buraqoon' is derived from Islamic history, specifically the story of Prophet Muhammad's Night Journey. In modern context, this name is used as a hashtag and in content creation on various platforms. On Instagram, users share beautiful images and graphics related to the story of Buraq and the Night Journey. On TikTok, creators make short videos about the meaning and significance of Buraqoon in Islam. On YouTube, educational channels create animated videos and explain the story of Buraqoon in detail, while some creators make poetry recitals and devotional music videos.
